complaint: A moody black-and-white photograph of shepherds was chosen for a gentle James Taylor lullaby. It suited heavy music, not this.
diagnosis: The pairing matched on subject (a cowboy lullaby retrieved herding imagery) and on energy (both low), which were the only axes scored. Nothing measured emotional temperature, so a bleak picture satisfied every check.

rejected.title: Two Shepherdesses Resting with Two Sheep
rejected.medium: albumen print from wet collodion negative
rejected.why: Dark and effectively colourless. Passed the fine-art, landscape, and energy filters, and its herding subject read as a literal title match.

tolerated.title: The Little Shepherdess
tolerated.why: Same pastoral subject and nearly as dark, but it holds warm colour. Pins the threshold: dim-and-coloured is a soft clash, dim-and-grey is a hard one.

preferred.title: The Harvesters
preferred.why: The same rural world, but sunlit and warm, and already widescreen for the television.
